environment.description: Document conversion microservice running on an EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023, t3.medium) behind an Application Load Balancer. The service runs as the 'app' user (uid 1000) with standard Linux permissions. The ALB forwards all traffic on port 443 to the target group on port 8080. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 on the ALB and inbound 8080 from the ALB SG on the instance. The instance has pandoc 3.1, exiftool 12.6, and xelatex installed. IAM instance profile has S3 read access for fetching templates. No additional runtime restrictions beyond standard Linux DAC.
